result.topic_en: Scattered calculations on sums of square roots of products of linear forms and on quadratic forms in x, y, z, t, including bilinear relations and parameter substitutions, probably connected with theta relations or quartic surfaces.

methods.what: Rationalising a sum of three square roots of products of linear forms into a polynomial relation
Writing a quartic as a perfect square plus correction to express a curve as phi + f sqrt(t)=0, with phi^2 - t f^2 giving the curve
Determining special points via simultaneous vanishing f=0, phi=0
Completing the square in q for the quadratic form
Orthogonality (bilinear) conditions among systems of point coordinates
Bilinear forms with permuted coordinate pairings and parameters lambda, mu, nu as ratios of coefficients
Linear relations between coefficient systems scaled by parameters
